sections.Intro: This remedy is indicated in cases of malignant diseases, especially of the throat. It is useful in cases of low-grade fevers, with extreme debility and a tendency to a typhoid state. The patient is dull, confused, and may be semi-conscious. There is a general foulness of all secretions.
sections.Mind: Dull and confused. Semi-conscious. Anxiety and restlessness.
sections.Head: Dull headache, with a sensation of weight. Vertigo.
sections.Face: Dark red or mahogany color. Expression of pain and anxiety.
sections.Throat: Swollen and dark red. Ulcers on the tonsils. Foul-smelling breath. Hawking of bloody mucus.
sections.Abdomen: Tender and distended. Chronic diarrhoea of foul-smelling stools.
sections.Respiratory: Shortness of breath. Cough, with bloody expectoration.
sections.Skin: Dark red or purple eruptions. Petechiae.
sections.Modalities: Worse from motion and in the morning.
